title: Replication materials for 'Institutional Constraints and Public Data Commercialization: Evidence from a Chinese Meteorological Media Enterprise'
description: Python code (thesis Appendix C), Mplus 8.8 input files, requirements.txt and a fully synthetic replication dataset (300 employees x 6 waves, 9 business units) for the Teesside University doctoral thesis by Bai Yu. The real Huafeng Group panel is not deposited (organisational confidentiality agreements, thesis Appendix H.2); the synthetic data reproduce the variable structure and the published moments so that every analysis runs end-to-end.
